dev-ci-bot: [auto] pipeline #6123 (PR 6123) failed on stage `push-image`

dev-ci-bot: error: failed to push layer
```
Pushing layer sha256:bd3f...
Put https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/redwood-images/blobs/uploads/abcd-1234: net/http: wrote more bytes than declared Content-Length (wrote 5242881, declared 5242880)
```

maria: hmm saw this when I switched an ADD -> COPY for the app tarball in the Dockerfile on that PR. pushed via kaniko in CI. could the streaming differ? :thinking:

ash: that exact error usually means the proxy/nginx truncated or mis-handled chunked vs content-length. which builder image are you using?

maria: kaniko executor gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:v1.9.1 in our buildkite job `build-and-push`

leo: @maria can you attach the kaniko log? registry nginx logs show an upstream prematurely closed connection around the same time. i grabbed a snippet: 
```
2026-03-12T14:02:11Z error: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.2.45, server: registry, request: "PUT /v2/redwood-images/blobs/uploads/ HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://registry-backend:5000/0", host: "registry.redwood.internal"
```

registry-admin-bot: found event: PUT with content-length mismatch; client=ci-worker-12; declared=5242880; received=5242881

ash: could be kaniko writing an extra byte on retry or the proxy rewriting headers. options: upgrade kaniko, toggle chunked uploads in proxy, or switch to buildkit/dockerd for a test. also try setting BUILD_PUSH_RETRIES=1 to avoid partial double-write.

maria: re-running now with kaniko v1.11.0 and BUILD_PUSH_RETRIES=1, also uploading full /kaniko/.log artifact to the job

dev-ci-bot: buildkite #9876 re-run triggered by maria (user: maria)

maria: quick workaround idea: avoid streaming ADD-from-url in the Dockerfile; curl the tarball in a RUN step and then COPY the file in — non-streaming should produce stable Content-Length. i'll try that if rerun flaps.

leo: if rerun passes mark it flaky for now and file infra ticket to upgrade kaniko + investigate proxy header handling. if it fails, bisect by reverting the ADD change in the PR. @ash can you put up a revert PR quickly?

ash: yep i'll open a revert PR in ~10m to check.

maria: thanks! grabbing artifacts now and will paste the kaniko error logs into the ticket. :thumbsup:

dev-ci-bot: buildkite #9876 finished: passed (push step SUCCEEDED on retry)

maria: confirmed pass on retry. i'm going to (1) add kaniko upgrade ticket, (2) file proxy header handling issue, and (3) optionally change Dockerfile to avoid streaming download. will follow up in a ticket and link here.

leo: perfect. marking this thread resolved for now — reopen if it recurs.
